finalists.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and decisive findings, including high titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies, low complement C3 levels, and pericardial effusion.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate has findings such as mucosal pallor and non-tender, rubbery axillary and inguinal lymphadenopathy, and bilateral pleural effusions, although the CT scans and lymph node biopsy were negative for malignancy.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive findings, including high titers of ANA, anti–double-stranded DNA, and anti–Smith antibodies, which are specific to Systemic Lupus Erythematosus.
